findings.title: Protective exits can reopen exposure after short covers and flips
findings.status: repaired and independently verified on source SHA 08ae3381a453e88a85516ddc26955ea73467dbbe855fbaf3e71db6181c41fc8b
findings.trigger: Allow shorts; sell10AAPL@10; buy10 or15 with explicit target12/stop8; execute target at observed12.
findings.observed: Cover10 becomes flat yet creates sell10 protection; target creates new short10. Flipbuy15 becomes long5 but creates sell15 protection and target ends short10.
findings.expected: Create protection only for newly opened signed exposure; closing component must never generate a new position. Reject broker-native bracket cover/flip combinations unless leg quantity can match opened exposure.

def _fill(self, con, intent, quantity, notional, price, fee, clock, fill_key, source, source_timestamp=None, quote=None):
        if con.execute("SELECT 1 FROM p_fills WHERE fill_key=?", (fill_key,)).fetchone():
            return False
        book = self._book(con, intent["book_id"])
        pos = self._position(con, book["id"], intent["symbol"])
        old_qty = Decimal(pos["quantity"]) if pos else Decimal(0)
        old_cost, old_realized = (pos["cost_cents"], pos["realized_cents"]) if pos else (0, 0)
        delta = quantity if intent["side"] == "buy" else -quantity
        realized = 0
        if old_qty == 0 or old_qty * delta >= 0:
            new_cost = old_cost + (notional if delta > 0 else -notional)
        else:
            closing = min(abs(old_qty), quantity)
            basis_abs = abs(old_cost) if closing == abs(old_qty) else int((Decimal(abs(old_cost)) * closing / abs(old_qty)).quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
            closing_notional = notional if closing == quantity else int((Decimal(notional) * closing / quantity).quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
            realized = closing_notional - basis_abs if old_qty > 0 else basis_abs - closing_notional
            signed_basis = basis_abs if old_qty > 0 else -basis_abs
            opening_notional = notional - closing_notional
            new_cost = old_cost - signed_basis + (opening_notional if delta > 0 else -opening_notional)
        new_qty = old_qty + delta
        if new_qty == 0:
            new_cost = 0
        sleeve = intent["sleeve"] if not pos or old_qty == 0 else pos["sleeve"] if pos["sleeve"] == intent["sleeve"] else None

def _apply_remote_order(self, con, intent, remote, clock):
        qty = Decimal(str(remote.get("filled_qty") or "0"))
        previous = Decimal(intent["filled_quantity"])
        if qty < previous or qty > Decimal(intent["quantity"]):
            raise DeskError("Broker cumulative fill quantity is inconsistent; saved ledger preserved")
        if qty > previous:
            avg = Decimal(str(remote.get("filled_avg_price") or "0"))
            if not avg.is_finite() or avg <= 0:
                raise DeskError("Broker fill has no valid cumulative execution price")
            cumulative_notional = cents(qty * avg)
            delta_notional = cumulative_notional - intent["filled_notional_cents"]
            if delta_notional <= 0:
                raise DeskError("Broker cumulative notional is inconsistent")
            delta_qty = qty - previous
            actual_delta_price = Decimal(delta_notional) / 100 / delta_qty
            observed_timestamp = remote.get("filled_at") or remote.get("updated_at")
            observed_timestamp = timestamp(observed_timestamp, "broker fill timestamp") if observed_timestamp else None
            self._fill(con, intent, delta_qty, delta_notional, actual_delta_price, 0, clock, intent["id"] + ":broker:" + str(qty.normalize()), "Alpaca PAPER cumulative fill delta", source_timestamp=observed_timestamp)
        remote_status = str(remote.get("status", "unknown"))
        status = {"filled": "filled", "partially_filled": "partially_filled", "canceled": "cancelled", "cancelled": "cancelled", "expired": "expired", "rejected": "rejected", "pending_cancel": "cancel_requested"}.get(remote_status, "partially_filled" if qty else "open")
        if intent["status"] == "cancel_requested" and status not in TERMINAL:
            status = "cancel_requested"
        con.execute("UPDATE p_intents SET broker_id=?,broker_status=?,status=?,updated_at=?,completed_at=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE completed_at END,reserved_cents=CASE WHEN ? THEN 0 ELSE reserved_cents END,reserved_quantity=CASE WHEN ? findings.status: repaired and independently verified on source SHA 08ae3381a453e88a85516ddc26955ea73467dbbe855fbaf3e71db6181c41fc8b
findings.trigger: Use actual wall clock; expiry30ms ahead; fake get_order takes70ms then returns not found.

confirmed_guarantees_from_read_source: Separate p_ tables and per-book transaction-scoped cash/position mutations preserve legacy manual book isolation.
Funding and client intent identities check payload mismatch under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
Local fills maintain signed average cost, measured realized P&L, integer cents, unique fill keys and atomic event/equity changes.
Broker paths persist stable identity before send and recover ambiguous transport by client identity; acceptance alone is not a fill.
Broker cumulative deltas are unique and complete reconciliation writes rollback on read/shape failure; independent local funding/fill replay detects drift.
Versioned operator policies and empty strategy registry remain separate from research/inbox outputs.
Observed external positions/orders lock symbols; named broker book/account binding and duplicate account-identity checks prevent basic cross-account merging.
static_scope_limits: Confirmed source guarantees are bounded to read code and tested cases; they are not exhaustive behavioral proof.
Broker cumulative average fill receipts do not reconstruct exchange fill-level chronology; unobserved fees are zero observed fees, not proved zero commissions.
Sequential account/positions/orders reads are not an atomic exchange snapshot; provider timestamps/consistency checks remain material.
Model provider, off-host liveness and real Alpaca order transport were not exercised.
Independent probes verify reported repairs; this remains bounded paper-simulation/fake-provider verification, not a real brokerage transport or exhaustive behavioral certification.
